decisions.statement: A module's folder sits under a folder named `modules`.
A module naming the parts it is made of is a domain, and heads its own folder.
Such a module is let through wherever that module sits.
That folder sits beside the page the module is a part of.
A module under a folder beneath that one is under it all the same.
A folder named `.server` is a modules folder too.
Where a module sits is read from its path rather than from its body.
A file beside a module page is no module page.
A page of any other type is let through.
A path the change takes away is let through.
The parts a module names are read from the body the change leaves.
The index is not read here.
Alan approved this check in the turn that asked for it.
This check judges at every phase.

definition: the check refusing a module page whose folder sits under no modules folder
